milestones.title: Scope, rights and contracts
milestones.description: Month 1 target; ED-001–006: 48h work. Activate only on future selection; one-family scope, rights and CPU contracts.

milestones.title: Data and CPU baselines
milestones.description: Month 2 target with early-month-3 spill as needed; ED-007–013: 80h work. Small exact-label synthetic corpus and two bounded engines.

milestones.title: Frozen evaluation
milestones.description: Month 3 target; cumulative early phases may finish 4h into week 14. ED-014–019: 60h work. Frozen policy, evaluation, rights decision and CLI.

milestones.title: Functional public v0.1
milestones.description: Month 4, by week 17; ED-020–024: 52h work. Runnable local demo, package, reports and authorized publication handoff; cumulative work plus reserve 272h.

milestones.title: Review workflow and deployment
milestones.description: Month 5 target; ED-025–028: 60h work. Persistence, batches, deployment and optional feedback.

milestones.title: Pilot readiness and decision
milestones.description: Months 5–6; ED-029–032: 52h work. Pilot protocol or evidence-gap branch, operations, security, stop/go. Months 7–12 are recovery using remaining original hours only.

issues.title: Record future activation and portfolio capacity
issues.body:
### Goal

Establish the start condition.

### Implementation steps

On future selection record activation, capacity and calendar gates; create the hours ledger.

### Expected output paths

docs/activation.md; docs/budget.md; README.md

### Acceptance criteria

Explicit selection evidence exists; at most 16h/week portfolio-wide; first functional release targets month 4 within months 3–12.

### Validation and review evidence

Review date arithmetic and reconcile backlog totals. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-001.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

None; future explicit selection required.

### Data/method pitfalls

Repository creation is not activation; alternative projects cannot each claim the same capacity.

issues.title: Define the one-family workflow and discovery protocol
issues.body:
### Goal

Specify a falsifiable operator benefit.

### Implementation steps

Map matte_plate_v1 inputs, manual comparator, four result actions, error costs and exclusions; draft three optional feedback questions.

### Expected output paths

docs/product/use-case.md; docs/product/discovery-script.md; docs/product/assumptions.md

### Acceptance criteria

One operator/family/workflow is specified; cost assumptions and stop criteria are explicit.

### Validation and review evidence

Walk through nominal, anomaly and invalid-input scenarios; review discovery script. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-002.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-001

### Data/method pitfalls

No collection/annotation requirement. Outreach needs execution-time authorization; missing interviews remain unvalidated evidence.

issues.title: Audit code, runtime, model and data rights
issues.body:
### Goal

Make rights fail closed.

### Implementation steps

Build asset register; check exact intended uses, ownership and proposed MIT/CC0 decisions; document wheel/transitive notice checks.

### Expected output paths

licenses/assets.json; licenses/README.md; docs/rights-decisions.md; LICENSE and data/LICENSE after ownership decision

### Acceptance criteria

Separate train/evaluate/commercial_rnd/redistribute permissions; unknown/denied rights excluded; synthetic finish remains possible.

### Validation and review evidence

Review linked primary terms and allowed/unknown/denied examples. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-003.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-001

### Data/method pitfalls

Existing human annotations are allowed; noncommercial terms do not automatically permit product R&D. Runtime terms do not license weights.

issues.title: Timebox learning and inspect CPU constraints
issues.body:
### Goal

Reduce implementation uncertainty.

### Implementation steps

Spend 3h on array/raster conventions, 3h on calibration/metrics and 2h recording actual hardware plus a worked residual example.

### Expected output paths

docs/learning-notes.md; docs/environment-assumptions.md

### Acceptance criteria

Notes cover masks, leakage, nominal-only fitting and score non-probability; actual hardware is distinguished from assumptions.

### Validation and review evidence

Review hand-computable residual and nearest-rank examples against the plan. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-004.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-001

### Data/method pitfalls

No GPU, camera purchase, paid course or pretrained model prerequisite; unimplemented latency is not measured evidence.

issues.title: Freeze schemas, profile and contract fixtures
issues.body:
### Goal

Fix boundaries for conservative implementers.

### Implementation steps

Create all seven schema_version=1 records, matching Python validators and matte_plate_v1 profile; add invalid fixtures.

### Expected output paths

schemas/*.schema.json; src/edgedefect/contracts.py; configs/matte_plate_v1.json; tests/test_contracts.py

### Acceptance criteria

Records round-trip; unknown versions, NaN, escaped paths, invalid thresholds and incompatible hashes fail.

### Validation and review evidence

Run pytest tests/test_contracts.py; review valid/invalid fixtures. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-005.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-002, ED-003

### Data/method pitfalls

No physical units or factory acceptance semantics. Schema-breaking changes escalate to Astra; labels never enter scoring inputs.

issues.title: Create minimal CPU package and rights gate
issues.body:
### Goal

Make installation and asset access reproducible.

### Implementation steps

Create Python 3.12 src package and hash-locked dependencies; implement rights assertion and CLI check, including build/test/validation dependency notices.

### Expected output paths

pyproject.toml; requirements.lock; src/edgedefect/rights.py; scripts/check.ps1; tests/test_rights.py

### Acceptance criteria

Fresh environment imports successfully; denied/unknown required permission fails before reading assets; no deep-learning dependencies.

### Validation and review evidence

Install isolated environment; run contract and rights tests; record versions. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-006.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-003, ED-004, ED-005

### Data/method pitfalls

Audit binary/transitive components separately; no implicit dataset or checkpoint downloads.

issues.title: Generate deterministic nominal plates
issues.body:
### Goal

Create self-contained nominal images.

### Implementation steps

Implement seeded plate/background appearance, pose transforms and metadata; generate 64 smoke images and an automatic contact sheet.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/synthetic.py; configs/smoke.json; tests/test_generator_nominal.py; runs/smoke/manifest.json

### Acceptance criteria

Repeated pinned runs match hashes; empty nominal masks and known transforms exist; no external asset reads.

### Validation and review evidence

Run nominal generator tests and duplicate generation; inspect fixed sheets. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-007.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-006

### Data/method pitfalls

2D appearance is not physical evidence. Correct generator code and regenerate instead of manually editing or selecting samples.

issues.title: Generate scratch/stain mechanisms and exact masks
issues.body:
### Goal

Produce automatic anomaly ground truth.

### Implementation steps

Add shared-nuisance clean/defective pairs, warped/clipped masks, support/visibility flags and independent quality corruptions.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/synthetic.py; configs/defects.json; tests/test_generator_masks.py

### Acceptance criteria

Masks match injected geometry; hidden/outside-ROI defects are distinguished; nominal masks are empty; labels are automatic.

### Validation and review evidence

Test identity, rotation, clipping, occlusion and nonempty masks; inspect fixed overlays. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-008.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-007

### Data/method pitfalls

Mechanism masks are not physical defect boundaries after blur; quality corruption is not automatically a defect.

issues.title: Enforce grouped splits and freeze final recipes
issues.body:
### Goal

Prevent leakage before scaling.

### Implementation steps

Create 800 development images: 400 nominal train, 200 dev, 200 nominal calibration. Freeze 1200 final recipes before selection; enforce group/hash validation and robustness caps.

### Expected output paths

configs/development.json; configs/final.json; configs/robustness.json; src/edgedefect/datasets.py; tests/test_splits.py; reports/test-recipe-freeze.json

### Acceptance criteria

Pairs/variants never cross splits; counts match; deliberate overlap fails; final recipes remain unexposed.

### Validation and review evidence

Run split tests and validate-data on smoke/development. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-009.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-008, ED-005

### Data/method pitfalls

Different seeds alone do not establish independence; no manual curation or final-test browsing.

issues.title: Decode inputs and rectify the inspection ROI
issues.body:
### Goal

Provide bounded aligned arrays.

### Implementation steps

Decode PNG/JPEG with size/orientation rules; locate one convex plate, rectify to 256 square and retain invertible source transform with eroded ROI.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/ingest.py; src/edgedefect/geometry.py; tests/test_ingest_geometry.py

### Acceptance criteria

Malformed/oversize/multiple-object/singular inputs fail; fixture corners map within one canonical pixel.

### Validation and review evidence

Run geometry tests across pose, dimensions, orientation and invalid quadrilaterals. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-010.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-006, ED-005, ED-009

### Data/method pitfalls

Reject unsupported backgrounds/reflective parts; never infer missing geometry from generator labels or masks.

issues.title: Implement quality gates and retake reasons
issues.body:
### Goal

Avoid scoring unsuitable images.

### Implementation steps

Implement blur/exposure/geometry checks, envelope limits and reason precedence; select thresholds using development fixtures and freeze their evidence.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/quality.py; configs/matte_plate_v1.json; tests/test_quality.py; reports/quality-development.json

### Acceptance criteria

Failed quality bypasses scoring with null score; all threshold boundaries have deterministic reasons.

### Validation and review evidence

Run quality tests and development confusion table, including combined failures. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-011.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-010, ED-009

### Data/method pitfalls

Low-texture surfaces can be sharp; measure false retakes. Quality heuristics cannot prove domain membership.

issues.title: Implement robust template-residual baseline
issues.body:
### Goal

Establish the default objective CPU baseline.

### Implementation steps

Implement specified normalization, nominal median/MAD fit, residual/filter/top-1% score and non-pickle parameter bundle with provenance.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/engines/base.py; src/edgedefect/engines/template.py; tests/test_template.py; runs/template/model.json

### Acceptance criteria

Fit uses nominal train only; save/load scores agree within 1e-6; floors prevent nonfinite scores; outside-ROI pixels are excluded.

### Validation and review evidence

Test hand-computable arrays, constant images, defect injection and corrupt bundles. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-012.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-011, ED-009

### Data/method pitfalls

No final-data tuning or probability claims; parameter provenance remains separate from runtime licensing.

issues.title: Implement one handcrafted patch comparator
issues.body:
### Goal

Evaluate one bounded alternative.

### Implementation steps

Implement 16x16 stride-8 mean/std/gradient descriptors, nominal diagonal statistics and score maps; permit at most one development adjustment.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/engines/patch.py; configs/engines.json; tests/test_patch.py; runs/patch/model.json

### Acceptance criteria

Same model contract, finite deterministic output and nominal-only fit; no pretrained weights/framework.

### Validation and review evidence

Run descriptor, constant-input, reload and ROI-edge tests; record latency. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-013.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-012

### Data/method pitfalls

This is not PatchCore. A weaker comparator result is valid evidence, not permission for unlimited model search.

issues.title: Select the engine on development evidence
issues.body:
### Goal

Freeze a justified choice before final testing.

### Implementation steps

Compare template, patch and trivial controls; apply declared gain/coverage/latency rules; log all trials and freeze pixel threshold on development.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/compare.py; reports/model-selection.json; reports/freeze.json; tests/test_selection.py

### Acceptance criteria

Patch requires >=0.05 recall gain under stated limits; otherwise template remains; no final data read.

### Validation and review evidence

Test winning/losing/tied alternatives and replay compare. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-014.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-012, ED-013

### Data/method pitfalls

Accuracy alone is inadequate; do not select on public test labels or silently open another model search.

issues.title: Calibrate nominal thresholds and decision policy
issues.body:
### Goal

Separate score from operational decision.

### Implementation steps

Use 200 nominal calibration images for nearest-rank 90th/99th thresholds; implement precedence, nominal percentile and compatibility checks; finalize freeze receipt.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/policy.py; runs/policy.json; reports/freeze.json; tests/test_policy.py

### Acceptance criteria

Thresholds use calibration only; ties and four decisions are explicit; quality failure overrides scoring.

### Validation and review evidence

Test boundaries, quantiles, ties, missing bundles and hash mismatches. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-015.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-014

### Data/method pitfalls

Nominal percentiles are not defect probabilities; changes after final exposure require a documented new test cycle.

issues.title: Run protected evaluation and statistical controls
issues.body:
### Goal

Produce meaningful release metrics.

### Implementation steps

Implement tie-aware ROC/PR, Wilson intervals, confusion tables, pixel AP/IoU and grouped bootstrap; unseal final only after freeze checks.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/evaluate.py; tests/test_metrics.py; tests/test_evaluation_isolation.py; reports/final/report.json; reports/final/report.md

### Acceptance criteria

Counts/intervals/hashes and undefined-case reasons exist; retakes are not detections; review-all fails coverage; overlap rejected.

### Validation and review evidence

Run metric/isolation tests, hand fixtures, shuffled labels and frozen evaluate command. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-016.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-015, ED-009

### Data/method pitfalls

Synthetic prevalence differs from deployment. Failed performance gates remain visible even when evaluation software is correct.

issues.title: Measure robustness and generate failure gallery
issues.body:
### Goal

Expose failure conditions.

### Implementation steps

Run declared pose/blur/exposure/contrast/size sweeps with <=600 correlated variants; compute worst buckets and automatically select gallery failures.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/robustness.py; tests/test_robustness.py; reports/robustness/; reports/gallery/

### Acceptance criteria

Buckets contain counts and group intervals; selection is deterministic; unsupported probes stay separate; runtime/RSS recorded.

### Validation and review evidence

Run robustness tests and replay suite; review denominators and overlays. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-017.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-016

### Data/method pitfalls

No cherry-picking or claim that synthetic variety proves transfer to real images.

issues.title: Resolve optional public-data gate or record skip
issues.body:
### Goal

Keep external benchmark evidence optional.

### Implementation steps

Audit purpose-specific rights. If explicitly allowed and subset access feasible, adapt <=16 nominal train and 32 test MVTec tile images; otherwise record skip. Preserve official split and reserve nominal calibration.

### Expected output paths

docs/rights-decisions.md; reports/public-data/decision.md; optional src/edgedefect/public_adapter.py and tests/test_public_adapter.py

### Acceptance criteria

Permission receipt or exclusion exists; no unapproved download; results are out-of-domain evidence.

### Validation and review evidence

Review rights; if enabled, test counts/splits/hashes and report uncertainty. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-018.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-003, ED-016

### Data/method pitfalls

Noncommercial terms do not automatically permit product R&D; no bulk downloads, new labels or production threshold transfer.

issues.title: Wire CLI and shared inspection pipeline
issues.body:
### Goal

Expose stable reproducible commands.

### Implementation steps

Wire rights/generate/validate-data/fit/compare/calibrate/evaluate/inspect to modules; implement shared orchestration, exit codes and serialization.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/cli.py; src/edgedefect/pipeline.py; tests/test_cli.py; tests/test_pipeline.py

### Acceptance criteria

Smoke flow works; quality failure bypasses score; outputs validate and preserve provenance.

### Validation and review evidence

Run CLI/pipeline tests and documented smoke sequence in a temporary run directory. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-019.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-015, ED-010

### Data/method pitfalls

Labels never reach inference. A valid retake/review is a successful command, not an operational error.

issues.title: Build local single-image browser demo
issues.body:
### Goal

Make the result inspectable.

### Implementation steps

Implement loopback service and plain UI with import/profile/four outcomes/overlay; add token, Host/origin checks, size limits and queue bounds.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/service.py; ui/index.html; ui/app.js; ui/style.css; tests/test_service.py

### Acceptance criteria

Outcomes render without probability claims; overlays align; unauthorized/oversize/cross-origin requests fail; no external resources.

### Validation and review evidence

Run service tests; check keyboard, errors and four synthetic cases; save screenshots. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-020.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-019

### Data/method pitfalls

No internet-facing deployment or implicit support for other part families.

issues.title: Verify end-to-end behavior and failure paths
issues.body:
### Goal

Confirm consistent demo/report behavior.

### Implementation steps

Run generation-to-demo flow; inject corrupt bundle, wrong profile, invalid image and denied rights; compare CLI/service outputs.

### Expected output paths

tests/test_end_to_end.py; tests/fixtures/release/; reports/release-checks.md

### Acceptance criteria

Decisions/hashes match; failures never emit no_flag; reports reproduce within tolerance; public-data skip does not block.

### Validation and review evidence

Run end-to-end and complete tests; retain commands/results. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-021.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-020, ED-017, ED-018

### Data/method pitfalls

Software correctness does not prove detection performance or customer benefit; no hand-selected replacement evidence.

issues.title: Package and benchmark first local release
issues.body:
### Goal

Enable fresh CPU installation.

### Implementation steps

Build package, example bundle and offline instructions; measure 10 warmups/100 images and startup; document platform activation and bounded fallback.

### Expected output paths

scripts/package_release.py; docs/INSTALL.md; examples/; reports/performance.json; dist/

### Acceptance criteria

Fresh install runs offline; notices/hashes included; latency/RSS/startup measured against targets; unsupported platforms stated.

### Validation and review evidence

Install isolated environment and run smoke/evaluate/demo offline; record hardware. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-022.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-021, ED-006

### Data/method pitfalls

No hardware purchase or disguised accuracy changes when using reduced-resolution fallback.

issues.title: Write cards and walkthrough
issues.body:
### Goal

Explain exactly what evidence supports.

### Implementation steps

Write scope, rights, generation/method, results, failure gallery and gaps; record short walkthrough; update README honestly.

### Expected output paths

docs/MODEL_CARD.md; docs/DATA_CARD.md; docs/DEMO.md; README.md

### Acceptance criteria

Synthetic/public/customer evidence distinguished; metrics link reports; implemented/planned features separated.

### Validation and review evidence

Review cards against manifests/checks; follow walkthrough from fresh run. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-023.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-017, ED-018, ED-022

### Data/method pitfalls

No restricted thumbnails, factory guarantees or claim that no_flag certifies quality.

issues.title: Complete month-four functional release gate
issues.body:
### Goal

Deliver reviewable v0.1.

### Implementation steps

Rehearse installation/demo, verify notices/artifacts, write gate/notes and future publication handoff to authorized publisher; reconcile hours.

### Expected output paths

docs/releases/v0.1.md; reports/release-gate.json; dist/manifest.json; docs/budget.md

### Acceptance criteria

Generator/demo/metrics/limitations packaged; target month 4 within months 3–12; failed performance is labeled experimental.

### Validation and review evidence

Execute release checklist; archive hashes and later publication receipt only when actually published. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-024.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-023, ED-022

### Data/method pitfalls

Planning repository is not functional delivery. This task authorizes no remote writes; never mark failed targets passed.

issues.title: Add persistent review workflow
issues.body:
### Goal

Support auditable local review.

### Implementation steps

Child slices: SQLite/transactions 4h; queue/endpoints 4h; UI revisions 4h; crash/idempotency tests/docs 4h. All 16h counted here only.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/store.py; src/edgedefect/service.py; ui/app.js; tests/test_store.py; docs/review-workflow.md

### Acceptance criteria

Inspection immutable; events survive restart; stale revision returns 409; retries idempotent.

### Validation and review evidence

Run store tests and concurrent-edit/restart walkthrough; review migration evidence. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-025.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-024

### Data/method pitfalls

Operator feedback is not automatic ground truth; no user labeling or private corpus requirement.

issues.title: Add bounded batches and safe export
issues.body:
### Goal

Support repeatable small batches.

### Implementation steps

Implement sorted import capped at 100 images, cancel/resume, per-file outcomes and CSV/JSON export; escape formula-leading strings.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/batch.py; src/edgedefect/export.py; tests/test_batch_export.py; docs/batch.md

### Acceptance criteria

Resume has no duplicates; bad files preserve valid outcomes; hashes retained; resource/path limits enforced.

### Validation and review evidence

Test mixed-validity batches, cancellation, traversal and spreadsheet-formula strings. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-026.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-025

### Data/method pitfalls

Offline batch speed is not line throughput; exclude private image bytes from metadata exports.

issues.title: Harden deployment and rollback
issues.body:
### Goal

Make MVP installation reproducible.

### Implementation steps

Child slices: Windows 4h; Linux 4h; offline bundle/compatibility/rollback 4h; resource/failure checks/docs 4h. All 16h counted here only.

### Expected output paths

docs/DEPLOYMENT.md; scripts/package_release.py; tests/test_bundle_compatibility.py; reports/deployment/

### Acceptance criteria

Supported clean installs run offline; incompatible bundles fail; rollback works; actual platform evidence recorded.

### Validation and review evidence

Run bundle tests and fresh-environment install/rollback checks. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-027.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-026, ED-022

### Data/method pitfalls

No hardware purchase or untested support claim; narrow supported platforms if unavailable while retaining local CPU fallback.

issues.title: Rehearse usability and optional feedback
issues.body:
### Goal

Assess workflow understanding and benefit.

### Implementation steps

Child slices: protocol 4h; timed self-rehearsal 4h; up to three optional feedback sessions/coordination 4h; analysis/copy fixes 4h. Without participants use feedback slice for accessibility/error rehearsal. Total 16h only.

### Expected output paths

docs/product/usability-protocol.md; reports/usability.md; ui/

### Acceptance criteria

Comparator/tool times, misunderstandings and evidence source recorded; absent independent feedback explicit.

### Validation and review evidence

Replay three outcome scenarios; rerun affected service tests; retain permitted feedback evidence. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-028.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-025, ED-027, ED-002

### Data/method pitfalls

No fabricated interviews or customer-validation claim from self-testing; outreach requires authorization; no dataset requested.

issues.title: Prepare pilot protocol and resolve evidence gaps
issues.body:
### Goal

Reach readiness without a partner dependency.

### Implementation steps

Child slices: domain/error-cost protocol 4h; existing-evidence/rights audit 4h; authorized existing labeled-data check or synthetic rehearsal 4h; readiness/gap memo 4h. Total 16h only.

### Expected output paths

docs/PILOT_PROTOCOL.md; reports/customer/readiness.md; reports/customer/evidence-matrix.json

### Acceptance criteria

Ground-truth source, costs, confidence bounds and stops explicit; absent data means commercialization hold, not technical failure.

### Validation and review evidence

Review denominators/provenance or record unavailable evidence; label rehearsal. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-029.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-028, ED-018

### Data/method pitfalls

No new collection/labeling, paid annotator or mandatory private data; workflow feedback cannot prove accuracy.

issues.title: Implement retention, diagnostics and recovery
issues.body:
### Goal

Bound storage and recover locally.

### Implementation steps

Implement metadata logs, retention caps, dry-run scoped purge and backup/restore; document rollback; test synthetic operational shifts.

### Expected output paths

src/edgedefect/operations.py; tests/test_operations.py; docs/OPERATIONS.md

### Acceptance criteria

Image caps 7 days/200MiB and metadata 30 days enforced; purge stays in run root; backup restores; logs omit images/notes.

### Validation and review evidence

Test clock/size boundaries, invalid paths, restore and corrupt models. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-030.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-027

### Data/method pitfalls

Synthetic drift tests verify alerts, not factory drift detection; no telemetry/upload.

issues.title: Audit local security and artifact rights
issues.body:
### Goal

Verify actual MVP safeguards.

### Implementation steps

Audit loopback/token/Host/origin controls, decompression limits, dependency artifacts, notices and provenance; repair bounded findings.

### Expected output paths

tests/test_security.py; licenses/assets.json; licenses/NOTICE.txt; reports/security-review.md

### Acceptance criteria

Unauthorized requests fail; inputs bounded; packaged assets have allowed-use evidence; unresolved findings disclosed.

### Validation and review evidence

Run security tests and compare package contents to notice/rights register. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-031.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-030, ED-003

### Data/method pitfalls

Runtime terms do not grant dataset/weight rights; service remains local-only; no deadline-driven reinterpretation of unknown permissions.

issues.title: Close readiness and decide go/hold/stop
issues.body:
### Goal

Finish technical work with honest commercial limits.

### Implementation steps

Assemble v0.2 evidence; run smoke/recovery checks; estimate setup/support cost; reconcile hours and prepare authorized publisher handoff. Reforecast slipped work using remaining original budget only.

### Expected output paths

docs/releases/v0.2.md; reports/final-decision.md; docs/budget.md; dist/manifest.json; README.md

### Acceptance criteria

Readiness or prototype limits evidenced; missing external evidence means commercial hold; work+reserve remains 416h; month-12 deadline explicit.

### Validation and review evidence

Run full suite/deployment smoke; review evidence matrix and dependency receipts. Receipt: docs/evidence/ED-032.md (commands, results, hashes, hours, review).

### Dependencies

ED-029, ED-031, ED-026

### Data/method pitfalls

No claimed pilot without observations; planning is not functional delivery; record deadline failure honestly.
